subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the Control UI/Gateway structured reply-metadata coordination item, or should maintainers split it between https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 before closing it?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI UX, Gateway protocol shape, agent runtime context, and final-delivery semantics; an automated fix would need to choose product boundaries while related canonical-looking work is still open.

options.title: Keep As Coordination Item
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the Control UI/Gateway reply metadata contract and route final fallback semantics to the existing delivery issue.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Move the reply metadata scope to the open reply-metadata PR or a narrower issue and move no-output delivery semantics to the durable final-fallback issue, then close this mixed report with links.

options.title: Close After PR 90745 Lands
options.body: Treat the open reply-metadata PR as the candidate fix for the reply half and close this issue only after the final-fallback half is explicitly linked to its canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Keep As Coordination Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the Control UI/Gateway reply metadata contract and route final fallback semantics to the existing delivery issue.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz authored the maintainer-labeled final-fallback contract that covers one major half of the split decision and is the best available owner among the related evidence.
